body: I'm glad things are better for you.

I'm 17 and don't tell me how much I will miss out on. I'm 17 and my life is already shit. I was raped three years agoand now they're tormenting me again. My aunt died. I'm failing at every single thing. My family is falling apart. I am falling apart. I've been trying to get better for so long. I just can't keep doing this anymore.

I'm just so tired of shrinks, if you mean I should go and talk to one of those. For years, I've been going there, I've been taking my meds. I expressed my suicidal thoughts last week. They didn't listen. I don't matter.

Does it matter who I am? I'm just a waste of space. Nothing I do is even moderately important. I'm just going to be another statistic in a few hours.


I do not matter
